en.headline: Women’s rugby series at Kai Tak awarded M Mark status
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee recognised the WXV Global Series Challenger, which opens on Sunday with three matches at the Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground.
body: The Major Sports Events Committee said on Monday that it had awarded M Mark status to the WXV Global Series Challenger 2026, to be staged on 13, 19 and 26 September at the Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground.

Committee chairman Wilfred Ng said top women’s 15-a-side sides would play in Hong Kong over three consecutive weekends. World Rugby and Hong Kong China Rugby said the six teams are Hong Kong China, Brazil, Fiji, the Netherlands, Samoa and Spain, with nine matches played as triple-headers.

The first round on Sunday is Spain against Fiji at noon, Hong Kong China against Brazil at 3.30pm, and the Netherlands against Samoa at 7pm. The Hong Kong Tourism Board said gates open at 11am. Tickets are sold through the Hong Kong China Rugby platform.

zh.headline: 女子欖球挑戰賽獲M品牌 周日啟德揭幕
zh.dek: 大型體育活動事務委員會向WXV全球系列挑戰賽頒授M品牌認可，周日起一連三個比賽日在啟德青年運動場上演。
body: 大型體育活動事務委員會周一公布，向2026年WXV全球系列挑戰賽頒授「M」品牌認可。賽事將於9月13日、19日及26日在啟德青年運動場舉行。
委員會主席吳守基表示，多支女子十五人欖球隊將於接連三個周末在港作賽。世界欖球協會及中國香港欖球總會指，參賽隊伍為中國香港、巴西、斐濟、荷蘭、薩摩亞及西班牙，共九場比賽以三日三場連賽形式進行。
首輪周日賽程為中午12時西班牙對斐濟、下午3時30分港隊對巴西，以及晚上7時荷蘭對薩摩亞。香港旅遊發展局資料顯示閘門上午11時開放。門票經中國香港欖球總會平台發售。
